title: feat(plugin-security): a position declares its earlier names in renamedFrom, and its holders move with it at boot
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DSJXgEjeCBXs4y5kMcWfg7d)_ Fixes #32983 Clause-②: yes (widening) — `PositionSchema` gains an optional `renamedFrom` (a list of the position's earlier names). A position that does not declare it parses and behaves exactly as before; a declaration is refused only under rules that are new with the key. Metadata-protocol: added Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #33044 (skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md does not yet teach that a renamed position declares its earlier names in `renamedFrom` so its holders move with it) ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**:岗位可以写「曾用名」(`renamedFrom`)。新版本启动时，平台以系统身份把每个组织里挂在旧名上的任职记录(`sys_user_position`)改到新名下，只改岗位名这一列，重启第二次什么都不再改。这是裁决 A1(6841971722):只搬任职人；共享规则、队列成员、记录共享、在途审批、待接受邀请和停用台账里的旧名，只在启动日志里按表点名，不改写。 - **为什么改**:应用为避开同名岗位而改名后(HotCRM 18.4.0 改了 12 个),每个已安装组织的任职人还挂在已不存在的旧名上，静默失去该岗位的全部权限，只能管理员逐条改。现在声明一次，所有组织自动跟上。 - **风险与回滚**:这是一次以系统身份改变「谁持有岗位」的启动写入(ADR-0150 D7 补了一行)。裁决的三条条件都已钉死：旧名在停用台账里是停用的，不迁(否则人会以新名复活权限);旧名被别的包(含已停用的包)或环境占用、或台账记录在别的包或环境名下，不迁;两个岗位抢同一个旧名、或旧名仍是现役岗位，不迁。不迁的都以 warn 写明原因。**有一处按现有数据做不到裁决原文**:一个旧名若已没有任何岗位占用、台账里也没记在别的包名下，就迁给唯一声明它的包，因为平台没有别的记录能说明它从前属于谁(任何包本来也可以直接声明这个空出来的名字);详见 Acceptance notes,请批准时确认。只在启动时迁：运行中安装或升级的包，下次重启才迁；本次启动没能加载的包(例如 marketplace 重新加载被拒)占着的名字，这一轮看不到。同一人在同一组织已持有新名时，旧记录保留并点名，不删除。降级不会搬回。回滚即 revert 本 PR;已搬的任职记录不会自动回到旧名。 - **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`(判定顺序在 `carryRenamedPositionHolders`,写入只在 `carryHolders`)、`packages/spec/src/identity/position-renamed-from.ts`(解析期的四条拒绝)、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-start-hooks.ts`(在启动报告之前运行，失败不影响启动)。 - **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts`,预期 23 条全过；其中「condition 1」「condition 2」「condition 3」三组各自同时钉了拒绝和放行两个方向。 - **需要你做的**:批准时确认两点，都已写进 ADR-0150 的补充行：(1) 条件 2 的残余——没有任何岗位占用、台账也没记在别的包或环境名下的旧名，迁给唯一声明它的包；本次启动没能加载的包占着的名字也看不到，会被迁走且不会迁回。(2) 只在启动时迁，运行中安装或升级的包要等下次重启。其余由席位落地(含 `docs/adr/` 一行，按 Tier H 走批准)。 ## What changes Ruling A1 on #32983 (record 6841971722), executed as the seat's re-claim 6841987296 describes. - **`packages/spec` — the key.** `PositionSchema.renamedFrom`: an optional list of earlier names in the position-name grammar (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`, two characters or more, the same grammar as `name`). Its docblock and `.describe()` state what reads it and what it never rewrites. - **`packages/spec` — the refusals (condition 3), modelled on the field `renamedFrom`'s `refuseDishonestRenamedFrom`.** One position alone (`refuseSelfRenamedFrom`, a `superRefine` on `PositionSchema`): never the position's own name, each entry once. The `positions` collection (`refuseDishonestPositionRenamedFrom`, a `superRefine` on `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.positions`): never a name another position of the collection still declares, which also rules out a cycle, and never an old name a second position claims (reported on the later claimant, naming the first). Both live in `identity/position-renamed-from.ts`, which `identity/index.ts` does not re-export, so the public surface is the key alone (`check:api-surface` unchanged). - **`packages/spec` — the ledgers the new key and its refinements owe.** `liveness/position.json` gains `renamedFrom: live` with the executor named; `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` declares the new refinement sites (`identity/Position` root and the four installed-package API schemas' `manifest.positions`) and its header totals; the form reconciliation records why the Setup position form does not offer the key (a package author's declaration, like the field `renamedFrom`). Regenerated: `authorable-surface/identity.json`, `content/docs/references/identity/position.mdx`, `liveness/state-counts/position.md`. - **`packages/plugins/plugin-security` — the carry.** `position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`, run at `kernel:bootstrapped` from `SecurityPlugin`'s start hooks, before the catalog reference report (so a moved holder is not reported as naming no position). It reads every position's `renamedFrom` from the security catalog and judges each old name over the one catalog, since a parse sees one package body: - `claimed-twice` — two positions claim it: neither carries; - `still-declared` / `held-by-other` — it is a current position of the same holder, or of another package or the environment (condition 2, and condition 3 across packages). A DISABLED package's positions count: the catalog hides them, but a disabled package is still installed and the registry's one-holder rule says it still holds its names, so they are read from the registry with `includeDisabledPackages`; - `claimant-disabled` — the one position claiming it belongs to a disabled package: nothing is carried onto a position switched off with its package, and the first boot after it is enabled carries (a disabled claimant also counts for `claimed-twice`); - `owned-by-other` — it is no position now, but the activation ledger (`sys_metadata_activation.package_id`, ADR-0150 D8 R4) records it under another package, or under any package for an environment position, or as the environment's own (the `sys_metadata` sentinel the activation door stores) for a package's claim (condition 2). A ledger row naming no package is no evidence either way (it may predate the column); - `switched-off` — `readDisabledCatalogNames`, the authorization resolver's own read, says the old name is switched off: its holders would come back active under the new name (condition 1). Every holder and ledger owner is read through core's `catalogEntryAddress`, so the environment's `sys_metadata` sentinel reads as the environment, never as a package. A row whose write fails is named and skipped, so the rows after it still move; a read that fails ends that claim only. Either way the other claims run, and what moved is logged with its organizations. An old name it may carry has each holder row's `position` moved, as the system (`{ isSystem: true }`, the way every boot pass writes), one row at a time by id. A holder who already holds the new name in that organization keeps both rows: the old row is left and named (read first, and the `(user_id, position, organization_id)` unique key backs the read). Idempotent: a carried name has no rows left to read, and a row another replica moved after this one read it is skipped, not named as a twin. - **Holders only.** For each old name it carried this boot, the pass reads (never writes), a page at a time, and names by table, with row and organization counts: `sys_sharing_rule`, `sys_queue_member` and `sys_record_share` recipients of type `position`; `sys_approval_approver.approver` and pending `sys_approval_request.pending_approvers` slots `position:NAME`; pending `sys_invitation.positions`; activation-ledger rows. A table the composition does not register is skipped; a read that fails is reported as not read. No file in plugin-sharing, plugin-approvals or platform-objects is changed. - **`docs/adr/0150`** — one dated addendum line under D7 records the system write that changes who holds a position (condition 4). - Changeset: minor for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/plugin-security`. The ADR-0087 record of an addition is the `added[]` projection `check:spec-changes` computes from the authorable surface; an addition needs no `adr-0087:` marker (that gate judges breaking changesets only), so the changeset carries the two declaration lines and no marker. ## Tests - `packages/spec/src/identity/position-renamed-from.test.ts` (new, 15): an honest rename parses and keeps the key; a position renamed twice; the key is optional; the grammar refuses CamelCase, a leading underscore (field keys allow it, position names do not), a leading digit, one character, a space and a bare string; the own name and a repeated entry are refused at the entry; in a collection, two honest renames parse, a still-declared name is refused naming it, a cycle is refused on both members, and a second claimant is refused naming the first. - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` (new, 23), on a real `ObjectQL` engine over better-sqlite3: holders in two organizations move and only `position` changes (reason and validity window kept, rows of other names untouched); a second run moves nothing and calls no `update`; a twin holder keeps both rows and the old one is named; no `renamedFrom` anywhere reads nothing; condition 1 both ways (switched off: stays; recorded active: moves) through the resolver's own ledger read; condition 2 both ways (another package's or the environment's current name: refused; a dead name recorded under another package: refused; under the claiming package, or under no package: moved; an environment position claiming a name recorded under a package: refused); condition 3 across the catalog (two claimants: neither moves, both named; a cycle: nothing moves); holders only (a sharing-rule recipient and a pending approval slot are named with their organization counts and stay as they were, a non-pending request and a longer name are not matched); the boot wrapper never throws. Through the REAL reader (`createSecurityCatalogReader`) over the engine's own `SchemaRegistry`: a position of a disabled package is refused as held, and the same claim carries once that package is uninstalled; a disabled package's lone claim is `claimant-disabled`, and beside an enabled claimant both are `claimed-twice`; an environment position stamped `sys_metadata` is "the environment" as a holder and `null` as a claimant. A row whose write is refused is named and skipped: the rows after it move, and the next claim is carried. A ledger row carrying the environment's sentinel refuses a package's claim and lets an environment position's through. A row another replica already moved is neither moved again nor named as a twin. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: the served `position` card counts 14 top-level properties (13 + `renamedFrom`). - Moved with the new key: `scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts` (header totals) and `src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (the position form's omission entry). ## Acceptance notes - **Not covered by A1, as ruled:** the non-holder references (named, not rewritten), a downgrade carrying holders back, and Setup-authored metadata bodies that name an old position (not read). - **Ownership of a dead name.** Condition 2 asks that a package not claim an old name it never owned. The platform keeps no history of which package declared a position that no longer exists; the only stored record is the activation ledger's `package_id`, which exists only for a position that was ever switched on or off. So the pass refuses on that evidence when it exists and on any current holder (a disabled package's included), and otherwise carries for the one claimant, whichever package that is; the ADR-0150 addendum says so in the same words. A package that declares an old name nobody holds and no ledger row records can take that name's stranded holders; the boot log names every carry (old name, new name, rows, organizations) at `info`, so an operator can see it at the boot it happens. - **Disabled packages.** A disabled package still holds its position names (the registry's one-holder rule), so a claim on one of them is refused while the package is disabled and carries only once it is uninstalled. A disabled package's own claim is not carried until the package is enabled and the environment restarts. - **Loaded packages only.** The pass judges the packages this boot loaded. A marketplace entry whose rehydrate the engine refuses, or whose protocol range this runtime does not meet, is not registered at all this boot (measured on the existing rehydrate pins in `marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts`: such an entry's package reads `getPackage(id) === undefined`; a failure after a successful register leaves it loaded and judged). A standing claim on a position name of a package in that state is carried. Recorded as the limit in the ADR line; a stand-down would need the marketplace door to publish what it failed to load. - **Boot only.** A package installed or upgraded into a running kernel through the marketplace door is carried at the next restart, not when the upgrade lands (out of scope here, see the report). - **Twin rows.** A holder of both names in one organization keeps both rows, as the HotCRM script does; it is named for review in Setup, never deleted by the platform. The warning says that when the row on the new name is a time-boxed delegation, the old row is the lasting one to re-point. - **Field `renamedFrom` form entry.** The reconciliation's existing field entry still calls the field key "planned, not yet read" although it is live since #30885. Noted, not changed here (another key's record). ## Verification Final head and merge base are in the gates block below. Local scope per os-dev: the affected packages' own suites and typecheck, plus every family `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives; CI runs the farm. Head `cc6cce96cd` (main merged once, at `04c35f095`; the three commits after `d9befe7f9f` are the metadata-protocol count and the two review rounds' fixes, with no merge). Readings are on `74fff9ff1f` unless they name `cc6cce96cd`; the last commit touches only the carry module, its test, the ADR line and the changeset. - **Package suites.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: on `cc6cce96cd`, 265 files, 6551 passed, 45 skipped; typecheck exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 337 files, 22790 passed, 36 skipped (on `7a1bbb3f`; the fix commit after it touches no file that suite reads besides the spec rebuild, whose key count is unchanged). `@objectstack/spec`: the full suite ran before the merge (837 files); on this head the identity, stack, form-reconciliation and dropped-refinement files ran again: 16 files, 414 passed. The other suites that read `PositionSchema`: core `position-row-definition` 9, metadata `typescript-serializer-annotation` 7, downstream-contract 31, all passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0. - **Generated artefacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0 after a fresh `build`. - **The rehydrate limit, measured.** `marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts -t "notLoaded|failure after a successful register|register fault"`: 8 passed; the refused entry's package reads `getPackage(id) === undefined`, the after-register failure stays loaded. - **Dogfood.** Not owed: no `!` in the title and Clause-② is `(widening)`.
